signal: Fello launched Felix, an AI agent for real estate lead follow-up, in May 2026, scaling its proptech platform across roughly 3,000 real estate teams

email.body1:
Dustin, saw Fello launched Felix and is scaling across roughly 3,000 real estate teams.

A launch plus that install base usually means more in-market agents and teams than your reps can personally cover, and that is where pipeline goes cold before a follow-up lands. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Fello off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Dustin, quick follow-up for Fello.

With Felix live, the question is usually how many meetings the team needs to convert all the demand the launch is creating. Most teams find out late, and by then the quarter is a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Fello needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Dustin, last bit of proof for Fello.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Fello's reply rate likely compares to similar growth-stage startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Dustin, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Right after a product launch, timing is everything, and I know the post-launch stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Fello either way.
